states: Merge of origin/main 1f140a5d38 into #2434: both files carry the PR's controller-expansion changes plus main's Tailwind 4 renames (max-w-48/max-w-52 truncation spans, rounded-sm badges, dark:bg-blue-900/25 identity IP badge), checked on a private mock stack built from the merged tree

Workload Controllers table with DaemonSet, CronJob, Job and StatefulSet rows across three mock clusters: 1440 shows Scope and Detail, 1280 and 900 hide them, 390 keeps Controller, Kind, Ready and Issues; table width equals its container at every width, 1440 clips only one long StatefulSet Service detail, 1280 and 900 clip nothing, 390 clips only long controller names

CronJob, Job and StatefulSet rows expanded at every width in light (and dark at 1440 and 390): the CronJob section shows Schedule, Last run and Last success as absolute time with age, Active, Namespace and Cluster; the Job section shows Started, Completed, Duration 5m, Target 1 completion and Succeeded; the StatefulSet shows Service, Target, Current, Ready, Available and Updated; no value in those sections clips, and only the pre-existing Identity IDs clip at 390
interactions: Loaded /kubernetes per viewport and colour scheme, clicked the cron-nightly-backfill, nightly-backfill-28918234 and platform-observability rows to open and close their inline drawers
Ran a scrollWidth-over-clientWidth sweep over every controllers th/td leaf and every leaf inside each open drawer
Ran vitest for src/features/kubernetes, src/components/Infrastructure and src/features/platformPage on the merged tree: 90 files, 1504 tests passed
